stock: Execute a shortcut or workflow by running it in a new sidepanel window using the current tab (shortcuts and workflows are interchangeable). Use shortcuts_list first to see available shortcuts. This starts the execution and returns immediately - it does not wait for completion.
unnerf: Run a shortcut or workflow in a new side-panel window with the current tab. Shortcuts and workflows are interchangeable. Use shortcuts_list first to see the available shortcuts. This tool starts the run and returns at once. It does not wait for the run to complete.
